svg.text: Any periodic signal can be decomposed into a sum of sine waves at different frequencies
Composite Signal x(t) = A₁sin(2π·1·t) + A₂sin(2π·3·t) + A₃sin(2π·5·t)
Height of each bar = strength (amplitude) of that frequency in x(t)
e^(−i2πft) = cos(2πft) − i·sin(2πft) | Euler's formula decomposes the signal into sine & cosine components
